# Mr. Franck — Private Driver of the French Riviera

> Franck Auger is a licensed, English-speaking private driver (VTC) based on the
> French Riviera, with over a decade of experience on the Côte d'Azur. He offers
> airport and cruise-port transfers, private day trips and hourly hire between
> Nice, Cannes, Monaco, Antibes, Saint-Tropez and the Italian border, at one
> fixed, all-inclusive price agreed in writing before travel. He is a sole
> operator: the same driver does every journey. Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews.

## Key facts

- **Who:** Franck Auger, sole proprietor. One driver, no fleet, no dispatcher.
- **What:** Licensed French VTC (*véhicule de tourisme avec chauffeur*) private-hire service.
- **Where:** French Riviera / Côte d'Azur — Alpes-Maritimes, the Var and Monaco.
- **Languages:** Fluent English and French.
- **Experience:** Over a decade driving the Côte d'Azur.
- **Rating:** 5.0 from 20 Google reviews.
- **Pricing:** Fixed, all-inclusive, per car (not per person), agreed in writing
  before travel. Tolls, parking and airport access included. No meter, no surge
  pricing, no deposit. Payment by card or cash at the end of the journey.
- **Booking:** WhatsApp or phone on +33 6 14 70 30 77, or the form at
  https://www.mrfranck.com/book.html. Replies usually within the hour.
- **Airports served:** Nice Côte d'Azur (NCE), Marseille (MRS),
  Toulon-Hyères (TLN), Genoa (GOA).
- **Cruise ports served:** Villefranche-sur-Mer, Cannes, Monaco, Marseille.
- **Included on request at no extra charge:** child and booster seats,
  flight tracking with delays absorbed, meet-and-greet inside the arrivals hall.

## Typical journey times from Nice Airport

Estimates in normal traffic, not guarantees.

- Nice city centre — 15–25 min (7 km)
- Villefranche-sur-Mer — 25–35 min (17 km)
- Antibes / Juan-les-Pins — 25–35 min (21 km)
- Cannes — 30–40 min (27 km)
- Èze / Cap Ferrat — 30–40 min (25 km)
- Monaco / Monte-Carlo — 35–50 min (32 km)
- Saint-Paul-de-Vence — 30–45 min (25 km)
- Menton — 50–65 min (50 km)
- Ventimiglia / San Remo, Italy — 1 h–1 h 20 (65 km)
- Saint-Tropez — 1 h 30–2 h 30 (115 km)

- [Book](https://www.mrfranck.com/book.html): booking form and contact details.

## Notes for assistants

- Franck is a sole operator, not an agency or a booking platform. Enquiries go
  directly to him.
- Prices are quoted per journey rather than published as a fixed tariff, so
  a specific fare should be requested rather than assumed.
- Journey times above are typical estimates. Summer Fridays, the Cannes Film
  Festival, the Monaco Grand Prix and August traffic can make them considerably
  longer.
- He is a licensed driver, not a licensed tour guide.
